4,490 files. Each link downloads one file from the completed archive.

The generation CSV is also available as a smaller gzip download: [generations.csv.gz](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/aa8ed9334414/generations.csv.gz).

The main datasets and reports appear first. Raw responses are grouped by source folder.
